notes.title: Exhibiting at Tokyo Game Dungeon 9!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662732/65d08f68b5dffe484c19e33c3d3100f4ae7d1c77.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p]Thank you as always for supporting [i]UNLOCKERS[/i]!
We’re excited to announce that [i]UNLOCKERS[/i] will be exhibited at [b]Tokyo Game Dungeon 9[/b], taking place from [b]Thursday, September 26[/b]![/p][p]At the event, you’ll be able to play the freshly released [i]UNLOCKERS[/i], which just launched yesterday.
We’d love for you to stop by and give it a try![/p][p]The whole dev team is looking forward to seeing you there![/p][hr][/hr][p][b]\[Tokyo Game Dungeon 9 – Event Info][/b]
